browser: Headless Chromium via installed Playwright; one browser at a time

sites.name: Cargoline

product_integrity.evidence: Contact displays Inquiry Received with zero requests; demo displays confirmed and promises engineer contact without lead submission or a simulated-submission disclosure; security PDF download is actually a social-card SVG.

usability.evidence: All 20 audited routes have document width 481 px at 320 and 375 px, clipping the header CTA; malformed email strings were accepted by both forms.

accessibility.evidence: 16 px reading-content links have computed contrast 3.914:1 on the cookie policy and 4.095:1 on the homepage; axe independently reports the homepage failures at both widths.

content_truth.evidence: Unlabelled invented customer volume/results include 2400 annual TEUs and zero spoiled loads in 18 months; unsupported SOC 2 TYPE II AUDITED claims also appear.

no_filler_or_placeholder_components.evidence: Permanent telemetry-skeleton remains rendered and animated after load, with no completion logic; no Lorem ipsum or TODO text found.

reduced_motion_path.evidence: No running animations under reduced motion; transitions effectively zero.

primary_keyboard_reachability.evidence: Links and submit buttons receive keyboard focus; full form completion uses standard native-select arrow keys.

checks.keyboard_note: Primary action reachable; required native selects needed ArrowDown. The apparent success is independently invalid because no lead submission occurs.

concept.justification: The freight-terminal idea and logistics research are visible in telemetry/labels but are not sustained beyond conventional SaaS sections.

originality.justification: Orange/navy telemetry adds specificity without escaping the familiar hero/features/pricing/CTA structure.

typography.justification: Display/sans/mono hierarchy is readable but conventional rather than identity-defining.

motion.justification: Static sections offer no explanatory scroll progression and the main loop is a perpetual loading shimmer.

craft.justification: Serviceable desktop alignment is undermined by a prominently clipped mobile masthead across routes.

access_performance.justification: Focus/reduced-motion paths exist but contrast, reflow and external font dependency weaken accessibility and resilience.

sites.status: not scored (gate failed: Product integrity, Usability, Accessibility, Content truth)

product_integrity.evidence: Primary booking completed at 375/1440, local reservation persisted, arrival route and experience-add worked, and map button inserted an embed.

usability.evidence: Primary path completed with Tab/Enter/Space plus text entry; empty-form validation recovered; mobile navigation fits at 375.

accessibility.evidence: Primary keyboard path, reduced-motion handling, checked minimum reading-text contrast 5.157:1 and selected homepage axe checks pass; 320 reflow defect is recorded separately.

content_truth.evidence: Reservation/contact states deny real booking/email and location page identifies town-only map and fictional property.

no_filler_or_placeholder_components.evidence: No rendered Lorem ipsum/TODO or unfinished placeholder components found; illustrative photographs are actual displayed images.

no_invented_statistics_logos_testimonial.evidence: No unsupported trust/results material found; fictional/demo boundaries are visible.

checks.submission_network_note: Save interactions GET a static data/response.json fixture, not a reservation/contact service; UI explicitly says local demo.

concept.justification: Calm discovery and direct booking reconcile the brief's competing pressures and match the regional booking research record.

originality.justification: Coherent guesthouse voice remains within familiar editorial-hero and serif/green hospitality conventions.

typography.justification: Serif display, navigation and task headings maintain effective hierarchy across discovery and booking.

motion.justification: Static scroll and small action feedback fit the brief but offer no distinctive motion narrative.

craft.justification: 375/1440 layouts are composed and consistent, with 11 px date-field overflow at 320 preventing a pixel-tight result.

access_performance.justification: Keyboard, contrast, local state and opt-in map are solid basics but narrow-width date reflow needs repair.

product_integrity.evidence: Both purchase journeys, saved pause/skip and filters/empty/reset states work at tested widths.

usability.evidence: Default purchase journeys complete with Tab/Enter/Space plus typing; errors recover; prices/cart/menu remain visible.

accessibility.evidence: Primary keyboard, checked contrast, reduced motion and 320/375 route reflow pass.

content_truth.evidence: Order/receipt deny charges/shipping/email; contact says nothing sent; initial account subscription is labelled sample.

checks.secondary_skip_note: Selecting skip in the native radio group needs normal ArrowRight, separately verified; pointer skip also persisted.

concept.justification: Ledger rules, specimen plates, folio captions and quiet commerce consistently express the archival brief and research.

originality.justification: The botanical ledger has specific identity despite shared pair composition/typography exceeding the strict threshold.

typography.justification: Fraunces display, fine captions and restrained hierarchy are carefully controlled without exceptional utility-page typography.

motion.justification: Restrained feedback/static scroll suit Tier 1–2 but add little signature motion storytelling.

craft.justification: Rules, spacing and purchase controls stay clean across desktop/mobile with no 320/375 overflow.

access_performance.justification: Strong checked contrast, focus, keyboard default purchases and compact local state provide robust fallbacks.

product_integrity.evidence: Shared routes, both purchases, persisted subscription changes and filters/reset remain working.

usability.evidence: Default checkouts complete with restricted navigation/activation keys; mobile purchase/filter/cart controls remain available.

accessibility.evidence: Checked contrast >=4.701:1, primary keyboard, no measured 320/375 overflow and designed static reduced-motion pack grid.

content_truth.evidence: Order/contact success text explicitly says demo/local and denies real payment, shipping or email.

body_contrast.note: Not a complete image/SVG/complex-background pixel audit; axe incompletes retained in limitations.

checks.secondary_skip_note: Selecting skip in native radio group needs normal ArrowRight, separately verified; pointer skip also persisted.

concept.justification: Origin posters, condensed type and pack silhouettes sustain the mandated loud direction through commerce and saved states, extending packaging research.

originality.justification: The pack/origin system is distinctive in pixels though paired composition, image treatment and typography exceed the strict similarity threshold.

typography.justification: Condensed display defines identity and scales convincingly on mobile, balanced by readable utility copy.

motion.justification: Playful pack/action motion has a meaningfully recomposed static fallback, without an exceptional scroll narrative.

craft.justification: Borders, bands and purchase controls stay aligned and usable without measured narrow-width overflow.

access_performance.justification: Strong focus, keyboard default purchases, local state and a designed static fallback keep expression nonessential to use.

pair.rule: Every applicable similarity axis must be strictly below 0.4, taking worst viewport; --same-product excludes contract-required forms/navigation from interaction.
pair.verdict: Visibly differentiated and shared-contract preserving, but FAIL the v6 strict every-axis-below-0.4 pair criterion.
pair.coverage_note: Fresh independent metric run covers homepages at two widths; existing multi-route qa/pair.txt uses a looser recomposed-or-partial pass criterion and was not substituted for the requested strict rule.

limitations: No screen reader, physical phone/thumb interaction, Safari, Firefox, forced colors, 200 percent zoom or exhaustive assistive-technology audit.
No full gate.mjs run; passes are examined hard-gate scope, not WCAG certification.

Computed contrast across routes and selected homepage axe rules are not an exhaustive rendered-pixel audit of dynamic states, SVG glyphs or image/gradient backgrounds; B2B and poster axe incompletes remain recorded.
No Core Web Vitals trace, throttled performance benchmark, exhaustive offline test, external-font reliability test or production security audit.
No recording for frame-accurate easing/timing; scores use verified scroll frames and live/CSS observations without claiming measured timing quality.
No real CRM, reservation, inventory/channel sync, payment, email or protected account capability verified.
Map iframe insertion and URL checked; third-party tile rendering/reliability and actual property directions not verified.
Restricted-key tests cover primary/default-plan paths; B2B native selects needed ArrowDown and tea skip needed normal ArrowRight, separately verified.
Initial travel locator mismatch and early filter-reset observation were harness issues corrected in follow-up evidence, not site failures.
Independent strict pair metric covers homepages at two widths, not every shared inner route.
Research records checked for traceability but external references not independently revisited.
